name: Füzérradvány (Hungary)
description: Two equal vertical stripes of blue and white, charged at the centre of the white with the municipal arms of Füzérradvány: a crowned red and blue shield with a black eagle and a white mansion, within a green wreath.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.

features.role: Füzérradvány arms with crown and wreath
